description.text: Physics is the discipline that studies the most fundamental laws of nature, exploring the essence of matter, energy, space and time and their interactions. From the behavior of microscopic particles to the evolution of galaxies, from the gravitational force of an apple falling to the microscopic mechanisms of quantum computers, physics is the "basic language" of all natural sciences and engineering technologies, and also the underlying logic for humans to understand and transform the world.

duration.text: The Physics at Xidian University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

requirements.text: 1: Applicants must not have aChinese nationality.2:Applicants must be physically and mentally healthy (free from infectious diseases and any physical or mental diseasethat would have impact on the normal study), and must abide by Chinese laws and regulations, as well as XidianUniversity's school rules and regulations, and respect China's social morals and customs.3:Applicants must be at least 18 years old.4:Language competency 1) lELTS score of 6.5 or above 2)TOEFLscore of 80 or above 3)Duolingo score of105 or above 4)Applicants with a previous degree taughtin English may be exempted from providingEnglish language test scores if theyprovide relevant proof.
